title: An interview with Grindr CEO George Arison on turning the dating app into a "global gayborhood" hub with services for HIV treatment, hotel bookings, and more (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)
summary: Samantha Kelly / Bloomberg: An interview with Grindr CEO George Arison on turning the dating app into a “global gayborhood” hub with services for HIV treatment, hotel bookings, and more — Madonna made a surprise appearance in Times Square last week, promoting her latest album, Confessions II.
